title: Safety notice 2026/07: brake pads batch 2026-04 (simulated)
text: SIMULATED DOCUMENT. All names, events and figures are invented for the demo. Safety notice 2026/07. Operators of regional trains fitted with Fennic rail brake pads from batch 2026-04 are advised to inspect the pads before the next service day. Cracks were found in 11 pads on 3 vehicles. No accident has been reported. The manufacturer has withdrawn the batch and the office is monitoring the replacement programme.
